initial_client_mismatch.details: Initial native client encoded incorrect expected values for cvbr_0 and callcv_1; corrected by hand calculation; final GCC/Clang checks passed.

reducer_pointer_interpreter_setup.details: Initial fresh-process reducer invoked MIR_interp_arr before MIR_gen_init/MIR_link. In this harness that produced an invalid pointer-like result for its one-pointer fixture. Moving generator initialization/link before interpretation, matching the established corpus sequence, produced interpreter/JIT -127 with exact post-store bytes. This was a harness-order issue; it is recorded and no MIR source changed.
